acceptance.criterion: Existing engineering-domain registry is used; no parallel taxonomy.
Exactly one active executable engineering workpack is visible.
All holds are typed and carry blocking scope.
Duplicate active decision IDs are detected.
Controlled-value conflicts are detected for registered critical characteristics.
Waiting/parked work retains explicit resume triggers.
Source/books/standards registry is visible and source applicability can be traced.
Git/GitHub status is reported separately from engineering readiness.
Handoff acceptance verifies artifact existence, hash, archive integrity and required members.
FAST_CONTROL is read-only and does not mutate engineering state.
DEEP_ASSURANCE is only invoked at control/promotion/release boundaries or explicit request.
Known CF-001..CF-015 defects remain permanent regression cases.
User/operator control contract is visible and actionable.
